plan.summary: A well-rounded leg strength program focused on building power and muscle across all major leg muscle groups. The plan includes heavy compound movements (squats and deadlifts) for maximal strength, complemented by hip thrusts for glute strength and kettlebell swings for explosive power. This balanced approach targets quads, hamstrings, and glutes across multiple sessions throughout the week.

plan.notes: Primary quad strength builder. Start with a weight you can control for all 4 sets.
Posterior chain power. Focus on form over speed.
Glute strength and lockout power. Full range of motion.
Explosive hip power and hamstring engagement. Maintain hip drive.
Secondary quad builder with emphasis on upright positioning.
Hamstring and lower back strength. Maintain knee bend.
Unilateral leg strength and stability. Each leg counts as one rep.
